query: Adult C57BL/6 mice (P60, n = 10, Charles River, Wilmington, MA), sas4-/-p53-/- (Insolera et al., 2014) and littermate controls (n = 4/4, P28), rag2-/- shiverer and littermate controls (n = 5/5, P50) were perfusion fixed with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS.
matched_segment: Adult C57BL/6 mice (P60, n = 10, Charles River, Wilmington, MA), sas4-/-p53-/- (Insolera et al., 2014) and littermate controls (n = 4/4, P28), rag2-/- shiverer and littermate controls (n = 5/5, P50) were perfusion fixed with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS.

query: Ex vivo MRI of mouse brain specimens was performed on a horizontal 7 T MR scanner (Bruker Biospin, Billerica, MA) with a triple-axis gradient system.
matched_segment: Ex vivo MRI of mouse brain specimens was performed on a horizontal 7 T MR scanner (Bruker Biospin, Billerica, MA) with a triple-axis gradient system.

query: The specimens were imaged with the skull intact and placed in a syringe filled with Fomblin (perfluorinated polyether, Solvay Specialty Polymers USA, LLC, Alpharetta, GA) to prevent tissue dehydration (Arefin et al., 2021).
matched_segment: The specimens were imaged with the skull intact and placed in a syringe filled with Fomblin (perfluorinated polyether, Solvay Specialty Polymers USA, LLC, Alpharetta, GA) to prevent tissue dehydration (Arefin et al., 2021).

query: The total imaging time was approximately 12 hr for each specimen.
matched_segment: The total imaging time was approximately 12 hr for each specimen.

query: All 3D MRI data were interpolated to a numerical resolution of 0.06 mm × 0.06 mm × 0.06 mm to match the resolution of our MRI-based atlas (Chuang et al., 2011).
matched_segment: All 3D MRI data were interpolated to a numerical resolution of 0.06 mm × 0.06 mm × 0.06 mm to match the resolution of our MRI-based atlas (Chuang et al., 2011).

query: MTR images were generated as MTR=(M0−Mt)/M0.
matched_segment: MTR images were generated as MTR=(M0−Mt)/M0.

query: The mouse brain images were spatial normalized to an ex vivo MRI template (Chuang et al., 2011) using the large deformation diffeomorphic metric mapping (LDDMM) method (Ceritoglu et al., 2009) implemented in the DiffeoMap software (https://www.mristudio.org).
matched_segment: The mouse brain images were spatial normalized to an ex vivo MRI template (Chuang et al., 2011) using the large deformation diffeomorphic metric mapping (LDDMM) method (Ceritoglu et al., 2009) implemented in the DiffeoMap software (https://www.mristudio.org).

query: From the Allen moue brain atlas, single subject 3D Nissl data and 3D AF data (n = 100), which were already registered to the ARA space, were down-sampled to 0.06 mm isotropic resolution.
matched_segment: From the Allen moue brain atlas, single subject 3D Nissl data and 3D AF data (n = 100), which were already registered to the ARA space, were down-sampled to 0.06 mm isotropic resolution.

query: NF- and MBP-stained images of the C57BL/6 mouse brain were downloaded from the ARA reference dataset.
matched_segment: NF- and MBP-stained images of the C57BL/6 mouse brain were downloaded from the ARA reference dataset.

query: Images with major artifacts or tissue loss were excluded.
matched_segment: Images with major artifacts or tissue loss were excluded.

query: Small tissue tearing and staining artifacts were removed using the inpainting feature implemented in the photoshop heading brush tool (https://www.adobe.com), and dark voxels in the ventricles were replaced by the average intensity values of the cortex to match MRI data (Figure 3—figure supplement 1).
matched_segment: Small tissue tearing and staining artifacts were removed using the inpainting feature implemented in the photoshop heading brush tool (https://www.adobe.com), and dark voxels in the ventricles were replaced by the average intensity values of the cortex to match MRI data (Figure 3—figure supplement 1).

query: MRH networks are constructed using a CNN model with convolutions from the MRI to histology space.
matched_segment: MRH networks are constructed using a CNN model with convolutions from the MRI to histology space.

query: The networks were implemented using the deep learning toolbox in Matlab (https://www.mathworks.com) using the directed acyclic graph architecture.
matched_segment: The networks were implemented using the deep learning toolbox in Matlab (https://www.mathworks.com) using the directed acyclic graph architecture.

query: We chose 64 hidden layers (60 layers in 30 residual blocks plus four layers at the input and output ends), each with 64 neurons, which applied a filter size of 3 × 3 and included a rectified linear unit (ReLu).
matched_segment: We chose 64 hidden layers (60 layers in 30 residual blocks plus four layers at the input and output ends), each with 64 neurons, which applied a filter size of 3 × 3 and included a rectified linear unit (ReLu).

query: Most of the hidden layers utilized skip connections to jump over layers to avoid vanishing gradients (He et al., 2016).
matched_segment: Most of the hidden layers utilized skip connections to jump over layers to avoid vanishing gradients (He et al., 2016).

query: The network was initialized with orthogonal random weights and was trained using a stochastic gradient descent optimizer to minimize voxel-level absolute distance loss (Figure 1—figure supplement 2A-B).
matched_segment: The network was initialized with orthogonal random weights and was trained using a stochastic gradient descent optimizer to minimize voxel-level absolute distance loss (Figure 1—figure supplement 2A-B).

query: Several choices of mini batch sizes were tested and the size was set to 128 to attain a balance between training speed and performance.
matched_segment: Several choices of mini batch sizes were tested and the size was set to 128 to attain a balance between training speed and performance.

query: Stochastic gradient descent with a momentum beta of 0.9 was used for stochastic optimization, with an initial learning rate of 0.1 and a learning rate factor of 0.1.
matched_segment: Stochastic gradient descent with a momentum beta of 0.9 was used for stochastic optimization, with an initial learning rate of 0.1 and a learning rate factor of 0.1.

query: During training, the learning rate was reduced by a factor of 0.1 every 10 epochs.
matched_segment: During training, the learning rate was reduced by a factor of 0.1 every 10 epochs.

query: Maximum epoch number was set at 60, but early stopping was employed if the validation set loss did not decrease in five epochs.
matched_segment: Maximum epoch number was set at 60, but early stopping was employed if the validation set loss did not decrease in five epochs.

query: During hyper-parameter tuning, 1000 3 × 3 patches were randomly held out to as the validation dataset and isolated from the training dataset.
matched_segment: During hyper-parameter tuning, 1000 3 × 3 patches were randomly held out to as the validation dataset and isolated from the training dataset.

query: The weights from the epoch with the lowest validation loss were selected for final testing.
matched_segment: The weights from the epoch with the lowest validation loss were selected for final testing.

query: When retraining the MRH-AF neural network using MBP/NF data, we refined the last three layers' parameters while leaving the parameters in other layers untouched in the Matlab deep learning toolbox using the directed acyclic graph architecture.
matched_segment: When retraining the MRH-AF neural network using MBP/NF data, we refined the last three layers' parameters while leaving the parameters in other layers untouched in the Matlab deep learning toolbox using the directed acyclic graph architecture.

query: Specifically, the network training initial learning rate was 0.0001, while learning rate factor was 0.1 to accomplish transfer learning.
matched_segment: Specifically, the network training initial learning rate was 0.0001, while learning rate factor was 0.1 to accomplish transfer learning.

query: The t-SNE cluster was performed using the Matlab t-SNE analysis function on the network prediction based on values in 2000 randomly selected 3 × 3 patches in the mouse brain MRI data.
matched_segment: The t-SNE cluster was performed using the Matlab t-SNE analysis function on the network prediction based on values in 2000 randomly selected 3 × 3 patches in the mouse brain MRI data.

query: Following the perturbation method described by Olden et al., 2004, Rician noises were added to one input MR image to the pre-trained MRH networks, and RMSE between the noise contaminated outputs and the original output without noise was recorded.
matched_segment: Following the perturbation method described by Olden et al., 2004, Rician noises were added to one input MR image to the pre-trained MRH networks, and RMSE between the noise contaminated outputs and the original output without noise was recorded.

query: By repeating this procedure for all MR images, the sensitivities of MRH to each of the 67 input MR image or their contributions were obtained.
matched_segment: By repeating this procedure for all MR images, the sensitivities of MRH to each of the 67 input MR image or their contributions were obtained.

query: Gaussian random displacement fields were generated for pixels on a 1 mm by 1 mm grid in the coronal plane and propagated to other voxels by B-spline interpolations.
matched_segment: Gaussian random displacement fields were generated for pixels on a 1 mm by 1 mm grid in the coronal plane and propagated to other voxels by B-spline interpolations.

query: The displacement fields followed a Chi distribution with 2 degrees of freedom and were adjusted to match the level of voxel mismatches observed between MRI and histological data.
matched_segment: The displacement fields followed a Chi distribution with 2 degrees of freedom and were adjusted to match the level of voxel mismatches observed between MRI and histological data.

query: Statistical significance was determined using unpaired Student's t-test with threshold set at 0.05.
matched_segment: Statistical significance was determined using unpaired Student's t-test with threshold set at 0.05.

query: All statistical tests were performed with Prism (GraphPad).
matched_segment: All statistical tests were performed with Prism (GraphPad).

query: All values in bar graphs indicate mean + standard deviation.
matched_segment: All values in bar graphs indicate mean + standard deviation.
